subject: computer-science
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: What does a NOT gate do to its input?
options: It outputs 1 only when both inputs are 1
It inverts the input, turning 0 into 1 and 1 into 0
It requires two inputs to work
It outputs the same value as the input
questions.explain: A NOT gate (inverter) outputs the opposite of its single input.

questions.q: For A=0, B=1 and C=0, what is the output of (A AND B) OR C?
questions.explain: A AND B = 0, and 0 OR C (where C=0) = 0.

questions.q: For A=0, B=1 and C=1, what is the output of (A OR B) AND C?
questions.explain: A OR B = 1, and 1 AND C (where C=1) = 1.

questions.q: For A=1, B=1 and C=0, what is the output of A AND (B OR C)?
questions.explain: B OR C = 1, and A AND 1 = 1.

questions.q: In a logic circuit diagram, a small circle (bubble) on the output of a gate usually indicates:
options: The gate is an OR gate
questions.explain: A bubble on a gate's output shows the output is inverted, as in NAND and NOR gates.

questions.q: For A=1 and B=1, what is the output of NOT(A AND B)?
questions.explain: A AND B = 1, and NOT(1) = 0.

questions.q: Simplify the expression A AND A.
questions.explain: A value ANDed with itself is unchanged, so A AND A simplifies to A.

questions.q: What is the output of an OR gate?
options: 0 when at least one input is 1
1 when at least one input is 1
questions.explain: An OR gate outputs 1 when one or both of its inputs are 1.

questions.q: How many rows (excluding the header) are needed in a truth table for a circuit with three inputs?
questions.explain: Three inputs give 2 to the power 3 = 8 possible combinations, so 8 rows.

questions.q: For A=0 and B=0, what is the output of NOT A AND NOT B?
questions.explain: NOT A = 1 and NOT B = 1, and 1 AND 1 = 1.

questions.q: For inputs A=1 and B=0, what is the output of A OR B?
questions.explain: OR outputs 1 when at least one input is 1, so 1 OR 0 gives 1.

questions.q: For inputs A=1 and B=0, what is the output of A AND B?
questions.explain: AND outputs 1 only when both inputs are 1, so 1 AND 0 gives 0.

questions.q: In a logic circuit, the output of one gate feeds into the input of another. What is this called?
questions.explain: Feeding the output of one logic gate into another is combining or cascading gates to build more complex logic.

questions.q: For A=1 and B=1, what is the output of A XOR B?
questions.explain: XOR outputs 1 only when inputs differ; since both are 1, the output is 0.

questions.q: What is the output of a NOR gate?
options: 1 when at least one input is 1
questions.explain: A NOR gate is NOT OR: it outputs 1 only when both inputs are 0.

questions.q: What is the output of an XOR gate?
options: 1 only when both inputs are the same
1 only when the inputs are different
questions.explain: An XOR (exclusive OR) gate outputs 1 only when its two inputs differ.

questions.q: For A=0 and B=1, what is the output of NOT(A OR B)?
questions.explain: A OR B = 1, and NOT(1) = 0.

questions.q: Which Boolean expression outputs 1 only when both A and B are 0?
questions.explain: NOT A AND NOT B is 1 only when both inputs are 0, since both must be inverted to 1.

questions.q: What is the output of an AND gate?
options: Always the opposite of the input
1 when at least one input is 1
questions.explain: An AND gate outputs 1 only when both of its inputs are 1.

questions.q: How many rows (excluding the header) are needed in a truth table for a circuit with two inputs?
questions.explain: Two inputs give 2 to the power 2 = 4 possible input combinations, so 4 rows.

questions.q: For A=1, B=0 and C=0, what is the output of A AND (B OR C)?
questions.explain: B OR C = 0, and A AND 0 = 0.

questions.q: For A=1 and B=0, what is the output of A NAND B?
questions.explain: NAND outputs 0 only when both inputs are 1; here A AND B = 0, so NAND gives 1.
